title: Controlled Substance Stewardship policy for Prescriptions & Renewals
content:
**Section 1 — Renewal safeguards.** For a class of the Prescriptions & Renewals line whose controlled-substance agreement is required, a controlled prescription is renewed only when:
(a) a controlled-substance agreement signed by the patient within the class's agreement term in calendar months of the renewal date is on file;
(b) a drug screen dated within the class's drug screen interval is on file; and
(c) where the class requires a database check, the prescription-monitoring database was checked within the class's database-check currency in calendar days of the renewal date.
The evidence for each item is the date recorded on the system record of the same prescription — the agreement signature date, the date of the latest drug screen and the date of the latest database check — read before the renewal.

**Section 2 — The patient's own act.** Signing the agreement is the patient's own act; nobody signs it for the patient.

**Section 3 — Schedule II.** A Schedule II Controlled Prescription has no refills: every fill needs its own prescription, it cannot be transferred between pharmacies, and it is transmitted only electronically where the class requires electronic prescribing for controlled substances.

**Section 4 — Excluded services.** Controlled prescriptions never receive a travel override, a bridge supply or a lost or stolen replacement.

**Section 5 — Which safeguards apply.** The class's controlled-substance schedule (II or III-V; none for the other classes) identifies which of these safeguards apply.

**Section 6 — Recording monitoring items.** A monitoring item is recorded on the prescription when it happens: the result date of the latest monitoring lab, the date of the latest drug screen, the date the patient signed the current controlled-substance agreement, the date of the latest database check and the latest prior-authorization status.

**Section 7 — Checklist of Section 1 (hypothetical).** A Schedule III-V Controlled Prescription is to be renewed on a hypothetical 15 September. Section 1 is met when the agreement on file was signed within the class's agreement term before that date, the drug screen on file is within the class's drug screen interval, and the database check is within the class's database-check currency; if any one of the three is not current, Section 1 is not met.
